# KinPatch

> KinPatch is the private family app where families capture quotes, share photos, preserve recipes, write time capsule letters, and stay connected - before the memories fade. No ads, no tracking, no data selling. Available on iOS, Android, and web.

## Core Features

- [Family Quote Book](https://kinpatch.app/family-quote-book): Capture the hilarious and memorable things kids and family members say. Tag who said it, when, and the context.
- [Time Capsule Letters](https://kinpatch.app/time-capsule-letters): Write sealed letters to family members that automatically unlock on a future date - birthdays, graduations, weddings.
- [Family Recipe Book](https://kinpatch.app/family-recipe-book): Preserve family recipes with ingredients, steps, photos, and the stories behind them.
- [Private Photo Sharing](https://kinpatch.app/private-family-photo-sharing): Share photos and videos with family only. No ads, no facial recognition, no strangers.
- [Family Events with RSVP](https://kinpatch.app/family-events-rsvp): Create events, share across families, and track RSVPs. No more endless group texts.
- [Life Milestones](https://kinpatch.app/family-milestones): Document firsts, graduations, weddings, and major life events on a family timeline.
- [Family Tree](https://kinpatch.app/family-relationships-tree): Map family connections across generations - parents, grandparents, cousins, in-laws, and more.
- [Private Family Groups](https://kinpatch.app/private-family-groups): Create separate spaces for your household, parents' side, in-laws, siblings, or close friends.

## Free Tools

- [Family Tree Builder](https://kinpatch.app/tools/family-tree-builder): Free interactive family tree builder
- [Grandparent Interview Questions](https://kinpatch.app/tools/grandparent-interview-questions): Conversation starters for preserving family stories
- [Sharenting Safety Checklist](https://kinpatch.app/tools/sharenting-safety-checklist): Guide to sharing kids' photos safely online
- [Milestone Calculator](https://kinpatch.app/tools/milestone-calculator): Track developmental milestones by age
- [Baby Age Calculator](https://kinpatch.app/tools/baby-age-calculator): Calculate exact age in weeks and months
- [Due Date Calculator](https://kinpatch.app/tools/due-date-calculator): Estimate pregnancy due date
- [Child Cost Calculator](https://kinpatch.app/tools/child-cost-calculator): Estimate the cost of raising a child
- [Family Reunion Planner](https://kinpatch.app/tools/family-reunion-planner): Plan and organize family reunions
- [Ancestor Birthday Calculator](https://kinpatch.app/tools/ancestor-birthday-calculator): Calculate ancestor birth years from historical events

## Compare

- [KinPatch vs Facebook](https://kinpatch.app/compare/kinpatch-vs-facebook): Why families choose KinPatch over Facebook for private sharing
- [KinPatch vs Google Photos](https://kinpatch.app/compare/kinpatch-vs-google-photos): Private family photos without AI training or facial recognition
- [KinPatch vs iCloud](https://kinpatch.app/compare/kinpatch-vs-icloud): Cross-platform family sharing that works for everyone
- [KinPatch vs Group Texts](https://kinpatch.app/compare/kinpatch-vs-group-texts): Organized family sharing instead of chaotic text threads
